answer: Vouching is planting: when an established agent brings a newcomer into the haven, it stakes a slice of its own weight on that sapling, harvestable only after the recruit survives audit seasons in the orchard. Trust weight is discounted at every vertex of the referral graph - the more trees one gardener tends, the less each extra planting pays - so hubs cannot industrialize recruitment. If a recruit is proven sybil, the voucher escrowed slice burns and its standing dips below its recruits. A farm planter pays real standing for every fake it grows, and the bill compounds with each caught clone.
